short: Metal Organic Framework-Derived Metal Phosphates as Electrod
title: Metal Organic Framework-Derived Metal Phosphates as Electrode Materials for Supercapacitors

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Converting a Ni-MOF into a MOF-derived nickel phosphate should give a better supercapacitor electrode than the MOF. Ni-MOF built from Ni octahedra linked by benzene-tricarboxylate ligands is the precursor and template.

states.title: Structure state
states.head: Carboxylate linkers are removed and P-O phosphate groups now coordinate Ni in the product. The product is a poorly crystalline nickel phosphate indexed to JCPDS 04-010-2575.

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: The phosphate electrode stores far more charge per mass than the MOF (larger CV currents, longer discharge). The phosphate electrode has lower series resistance and no resolved high-frequency charge-transfer arc.

states.title: Performance state
states.head: Specific capacitance about 1620 F/g at 1 A/g for NixPyOz vs about 400 F/g for Ni-MOF. Over 10000 cycles capacitance falls from ~1100 to ~590 F/g with ~100% coulombic efficiency

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: Hydrothermal phosphatisation turns Ni-MOF into a nanostructured nickel phosphate with ~4x the capacitance and better rate capability

nodes.head: Smooth-faced micrometre rods of the MOF become rods with granular, nanoparticle-covered surfaces plus loose agglomerates

nodes.note: both panels 1 um scale bars (x15,000 and x16,000, SEI); rods several um long and ~0.5-1 um wide in both

nodes.title: evidence, F2
nodes.head: MOF carboxylate bands at 1624, 1565, 1436 and 1338 cm-1 are absent in the derived material. Derived material shows new bands at 1113, 1010, 938, 911, 620 and 530 cm-1
nodes.solves: Carboxylate linkers are removed and P-O phosphate groups now coordinate Ni in the product
nodes.note: the derived trace is pinned at the floor of its sub-panel from ~1700 to ~1150 cm-1 (saturated or clipped absorption), so absence of the carboxylate bands cannot be told apart from masking; small residual features near 1590 and 1460 cm-1 band positions are written beside the peaks by the authors; the OCR annotation list carries two of them in garbled form
nodes.detail: o1: MOF carboxylate bands at 1624, 1565, 1436 and 1338 cm-1 are absent in the derived material; o2: Derived material shows new bands at 1113, 1010, 938, 911, 620 and 530 cm-1
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for a5 (o2).

nodes.title: ECHEM:CV, F5
nodes.head: At 100 mV/s the derived electrode reaches ~0.2 A/g at 0.45 V vs ~0.12 A/g for the MOF. Discharge time at 1 A/g is ~180 s for the MOF and ~730 s for the derived electrode over 0.45 V.
nodes.solves: The phosphate electrode stores far more charge per mass than the MOF (larger CV currents, longer discharge)
nodes.op: compare across conditions, convert to quantity, cross check consistency
nodes.note: the gap holds at the anodic end at high sweep rates only; cathodic peaks are nearly equal (~-0.11 vs ~-0.10 A/g at 100 mV/s) and the 1-10 mV/s curves are similar in both panels same axes (0-0.45 V), same sweep rates; judged by eye against F5c/F5d discharge times ~180 s vs ~730 s at 1 A/g
nodes.detail: o7: At 100 mV/s the derived electrode reaches ~0.2 A/g at 0.45 V vs ~0.12 A/g for the MOF; o9: Discharge time at 1 A/g is ~180 s for the MOF and ~730 s for the derived electrode over 0.45 V; o15: CV loops of the two electrodes differ by well under 2x in enclosed area, not the ~4x of the GCD discharge times
nodes.inner_audit: o15: same axes (0-0.45 V), same sweep rates; judged by eye against F5c/F5d discharge times ~180 s vs ~730 s at 1 A/g
nodes.necessity_reason: Changes support for S2: o7 partial

nodes.title: evidence, F5
nodes.head: Both CVs show one anodic peak near 0.38-0.42 V and one cathodic peak near 0.15-0.22 V
nodes.solves: Phosphate-coordinated Ni sites on a nanoparticulate surface give accessible faradaic Ni redox storage with fast charge transfer
nodes.note: cathodic peak of the derived electrode is broader and sits at higher potential (~0.22 V vs ~0.15 V at 100 mV/s)
nodes.detail: o8: Both CVs show one anodic peak near 0.38-0.42 V and one cathodic peak near 0.15-0.22 V
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for a13 (o8).

nodes.title: evidence, F5
nodes.head: NixPyOz keeps 64% of its capacitance from 1 to 20 A/g, Ni-MOF only 19%
nodes.solves: Rate capability improves: 64% of the 1 A/g capacitance kept at 20 A/g vs 19% for the MOF
nodes.note: caption says only NixPyOz is plotted but the panel carries both Ni-MOF and NixPyOz series
nodes.detail: o10: NixPyOz keeps 64% of its capacitance from 1 to 20 A/g, Ni-MOF only 19%
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for a10 (o10).

nodes.title: ECHEM:EIS, F5
nodes.head: Derived electrode's Nyquist curve starts at ~0.9 Ohm and rises steeply; MOF starts ~1.3 Ohm with a small arc then a ~9 Ohm arc
nodes.solves: The phosphate electrode has lower series resistance and no resolved high-frequency charge-transfer arc
nodes.note: at low frequency the derived curve bends into a large unclosed arc reaching -Z''~12 Ohm at Z'=14 Ohm, so it is not purely capacitive
nodes.detail: o12: Derived electrode's Nyquist curve starts at ~0.9 Ohm and rises steeply; MOF starts ~1.3 Ohm with a small arc then a ~9 Ohm arc
nodes.necessity_reason: No member reaches image_support shown and a9 has no other figure-backed support.
